1e1a17fcb3e37aabc54d38e4328d0e58cea7e5dc.summary: SOCRadar's Threat Research Unit describes ICMacOS (Icarus macOS), a macOS infostealer sold as malware-as-a-service since early September 2026 and promoted by the Russian-speaking actor GlowComa. It is delivered through ClickFix copy-and-paste pages that show fake system dialogs to capture the login password. It steals browser data, crypto wallets, messaging data, keychain contents and developer secrets. Version 2 adds a persistent RAT with a LaunchAgent and WebSocket-driven remote shell access. The malware checks locale and IP address to avoid Russia and CIS countries.
